title: Power BI Dataflow Refresh Failures
dataSources: Power BI activity events (`o365:management:activity` with `Workload=PowerBI`), Power BI REST Admin API (`/admin/groups`, `/datasets/refreshes`, `/capacities/refreshables`), on-prem data gateway `Mashup`/`GatewayInfo` logs, Premium capacity metrics.
app: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services / Microsoft 365 (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`) for the Power BI activity log; Power BI REST Admin API and on-prem data gateway logs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=o365:management:activity Workload=PowerBI Activity=RefreshDataflow
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(Result="Failed")) as failures by DataflowName, WorkspaceName
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Tracks Power BI dataflow refreshes and flags failures, which break every dataset and report that consumes the dataflow's prepared entities.
value: Dataflows feed multiple datasets; a failed dataflow refresh cascades to many reports, so catching it early protects the whole downstream chain.
implementation: Ingest the activity log; schedule hourly; alert on dataflow refresh failures. Map dataflows to consuming datasets for impact.
visualization: Table of failing dataflows, timechart of failures.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities (audit log)

grandmaExplanation: We watch the shared data-preparation steps in Power BI so when one fails you know before it spoils all the reports built on it.
